text:
Priya (BizOps): Heads up - company card was declined on an Uber yesterday for an onsite candidate pickup. I used personal card to complete and Uber added a service surcharge of $3.50 for 'airport pick-up'. Do we reimburse the surcharge? Also I don't have an itemized invoice, just the trip receipt email and my personal card statement.
expense-bot: Reminder: For non-company-card charges, attach the merchant receipt and the personal card statement line showing the charge.
Priya (BizOps): attaching trip email (shows fare $27.80 + surcharge $3.50 = $31.30) and screenshot of my bank showing $31.30 posted. I left a note in the expense form: "company card declined - used personal card".
Elaine (Finance): Thanks. Policy: base fares and required surcharges are reimbursable if they are part of the merchant's posted charge and the spend is work-related. Voluntary extras (like in-app tips) are reimbursed only if properly documented. This surcharge looks like a mandatory airport pickup fee. We'll need the Uber trip receipt (usually the email includes breakdown) and the card statement.
Priya (BizOps): the email has the breakdown but it's tiny, I can forward the email as a PDF. Does the fact the corporate card declined change anything?
Marcus (IT): quick note: we've seen tokenization issues with the corporate card at some Uber terminals. I'll open a ticket with procurement and card provider.
Elaine (Finance): For this reimbursement: please forward the Uber receipt PDF and personal card screenshot into the expense system. I'll approve the $31.30 (fare + surcharge) once docs are uploaded. We will code to BIZOPS-Q2 and mark as "personal card reimbursement".
Priya (BizOps): uploaded both. Also added manager approval (line manager cc'ed).
expense-bot: Expense created: "Uber - candidate pickup" status: awaiting approval. Link: https://expenses.internal/reports/EXP-2550
Elaine (Finance): Approved. Payment scheduled for next run. Also adding a note to FIN-ops to allow automatic reimbursement for mandatory carrier surcharges under $10 with proper receipts to reduce manual approvals.
Priya (BizOps): thank you! and +1 on the automation idea.
Marcus (IT): ticket opened with card provider (CARD-775) to investigate decline pattern.
Priya (BizOps): resolved for me, appreciate the quick turnaround. :smile:
